experiment_data.hypothesis: Controlling for individual model robustness (η_max), higher K_eff panels have significantly lower ASR. The SDPI bound η_joint ≤ K_eff · η_max has two factors: K_eff (diversity) and η_max (weakest-link robustness). Step 2 v2 confounded them. Multi-factor regression log(ASR) ~ log(K_eff) + log(η_max) should show K_eff coefficient significantly negative.
